name: Jain Irrigation Systems Limited
summary: Jain Irrigation Systems Limited manufactures and sells precision-irrigation systems in India, Europe, North America, and internationally. The company operates through Hi-Tech Agri Input Products; Plastic Division; and Agro Processing Division segments. It provides drip irrigation; micro and mini sprinklers; sprinkler irrigation systems; filters, dosing pumps, and injectors; PVC and PE pipes and fittings; plastic sheets; hi-tech planting material; green energy products; environment-controlled agriculture; polypropylene piping products; and plumbing systems.
